D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the first concert of the
Summer Concert Series will take place on June 13, 2025; and that the Youth Soccer Program will hold
its Closing Ceremony on June 14, 2025.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that a Community Block Cleanup will be held on
June 14, 2025; and a tire recycle event will be held on June 14, 2025.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced that he requested a more proactive effort from LASD to
curtail the illegal fireworks activity in the city.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that Public Safety collaborated with Public Works for
new digital street signs educating the community of the new illegal fireworks fines.

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa thanked staff for their work in approving the two­year city budget; and announced
he stands in solidarity with the immigrant community.

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio announced she stands in solidarity with the immigrant community.

Mayor De Paula delivered a message that the City of Hawaiian Gardens does not collaborate
or participate in any Federal Immigration Enforcement activity.
